description: List GPU nodes available to rent right now, with price per hour, GPU model, VRAM, CUDA compute capability, and country. Rent by the returned node_id. reserved_for_you: true marks a node its provider keeps for this key's person or organization: such nodes come first and nobody else sees them. Read-only, no cost. For modern LLM work prefer compute_cap >= 8.9 (FP8).
name: list_gpus
